name: pey.chat
description: Conversation logic for a single in-memory chat with a language model: history, system instruction, per-message context, progressive answer delivery, stop and retry with a sending-history cap. Holds no key and no connection settings — pey.llm owns those; presentation stays with the UI.

provides.name: pey.chat.service
provides.description: One conversation, in memory. Message text and context never appear in events or errors — events carry message ids only. Streaming answers follow the shared flow pattern: the caller hands in text handlers and receives a handle with cancel() and a done promise that resolves exactly one of three endings — completed, interrupted (with the pey.llm error passed through), or cancelled. pey.llm error codes reach the caller unchanged; this plugin adds only its own chat codes.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Appends a user message (with optional context, e.g. a document selection) and starts generating the assistant answer. Delivery is progressive through handlers.onText; on completion the assistant message is registered and chat:message-completed carries its id. A second send while an answer is being generated is rejected.

params.name: input
params.type: { text: string, context?: string } — empty or blank text is rejected

methods.returns: Promise<{ cancel: () => void, done: Promise<{ ending: 'completed' } | { ending: 'interrupted', error: object } | { ending: 'cancelled' }> }>

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the answer currently being generated, if any. The partial text received so far stays in history marked incomplete. A no-op when nothing is in flight.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Regenerates the answer for the last user message without repeating the message. The previous answer (complete, incomplete or failed) stays untouched until the first new text arrives, then is replaced by the new one; a failure before any text keeps the previous answer. Never automatic — every retry is an explicit caller request.
methods.returns: Promise<{ cancel: () => void, done: Promise<{ ending: 'completed' } | { ending: 'interrupted', error: object } | { ending: 'cancelled' }> }>

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Empties the conversation and publishes chat:history-cleared.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns a read-only copy of the conversation: every message with its unique id, role, content parts (the user's message carries its context), status ('complete' or 'incomplete') and timestamp. Untouched by the sending-history cap — the cap trims only what goes to the model.
methods.returns: Array<{ id: string, role: 'user'|'assistant', parts: Array<object>, status: string, at: number }>

events.name: chat:message-completed
events.description: Published after an assistant answer was registered completely. Data: the assistant message id.

events.name: chat:history-cleared
events.description: Published when the conversation was cleared. Carries no data.
